name: C11_PI_VERTEX_SEPARATOR2_COMPOSITION_GATE_V1

definition: C is a connected authoritative C11 PI residual component after only frozen deterministic propagation/normalization.
C is NOT_TW3_LIST_READY, with tw(C)>3 certified when needed by a frozen forbidden-minor model.
C is not exactly a six-vertex literal octahedron eligible for the exact-octahedron terminal.
domain.rationale: This gate continues the actually verified S2 Path-A lineage and asks whether the remaining cut-vertex-free interaction factorizes across a separator of exactly two vertices.

base_terminal_stack.L3_READY: Global missing color followed by frozen P7-free List-3.
base_terminal_stack.TW3_LIST_READY: Verified width-3 decomposition followed by frozen arbitrary-list TW3 DP.
base_terminal_stack.LITERAL_OCTAHEDRON_EXACT_LIST_READY: Entire component exactly a six-vertex K_{2,2,2}, solved by direct <=4^6 enumeration.

separator2_discovery.Sep_2_C: All unordered 2-subsets S of V(C) such that C-S is disconnected.
separator2_discovery.algorithm: Enumerate all O(n^2) unordered pairs S, delete S, compute connected components, retain exactly those with at least two components.

separator_state_semantics.Col_L_S: All assignments psi:S->[4] that respect both exact lists and are proper on C[S].
separator_state_semantics.empty_state_rule: If Col_L(S)=empty, then S is automatically a GOOD_2 separator (CORE/BOUNDARY_UNSAT): no coloring of C can restrict to a proper list-respecting coloring on S.

closed_definition.formula: Closed(C,S,psi) holds iff after fixing every s in S to psi(s) and applying only frozen deterministic propagation, the branch is CONTRADICTION or every surviving connected component is closed by the base terminal stack.
closed_definition.component_logic: For a fixed psi, exact two-vertex separator factorization makes the surviving C-S components independent once all boundary-color restrictions are reflected in their lists.

good2_definition.per_separator: GOOD_2(C,S) := S in Sep_2(C) AND [Col_L(S)=empty OR for every psi in Col_L(S): Closed(C,S,psi)].
good2_definition.per_residual: GOOD_2(C) := exists S in Sep_2(C): GOOD_2(C,S).

exact_negation_binding.formula: not GOOD_2(C) iff Sep_2(C)=empty OR for every S in Sep_2(C): [Col_L(S) is nonempty AND exists psi_S in Col_L(S) such that not Closed(C,S,psi_S)].
exact_negation_binding.rule: A single bad separator or a single bad boundary assignment is LOCAL_SEPARATOR2_ESCAPE only and MUST NOT falsify GOOD_2(C).
exact_negation_binding.empty_assignment_consequence: Any S with Col_L(S)=empty is a good separator and blocks strong negative outcome for that C.

for_each_S: Enumerate every proper list-respecting psi in Col_L(S), at most 16.
Fix psi and apply only frozen deterministic propagation.
If contradiction arises, branch is CLOSED.
Otherwise compute every surviving connected component Q.
Classify each Q in strict order: L3_READY, TW3_LIST_READY, LITERAL_OCTAHEDRON_EXACT_LIST_READY, otherwise ESCAPE.
per_separator_audit.branch_closed_iff: Every surviving component is closed by the base terminal stack.

R1_SEPARATOR2_COMPOSITION_UNIVERSAL.label: R1_SEPARATOR2_COMPOSITION_UNIVERSAL
R1_SEPARATOR2_COMPOSITION_UNIVERSAL.formula: For every C in the frozen domain, GOOD_2(C).
pass_requires: A theorem/proof-carrying universal argument; finite corpus success is insufficient.
A polynomial graph-only method finding at least one good 2-separator S(C) for every domain residual.
For every proper list-respecting boundary assignment psi on S(C), all branches close through the frozen base terminal stack.
Exact SAT reconstruction / UNSAT aggregation over at most 16 separator states.
Polynomial accounting for separator enumeration, propagation, component decomposition, and downstream terminals.
R1_SEPARATOR2_COMPOSITION_UNIVERSAL.consequence_ceiling: The current cut-vertex-free authoritative residual family is polynomially resolved by graph-discoverable two-vertex separator composition.

LOCAL_SEPARATOR2_ESCAPE.label: LOCAL_SEPARATOR2_ESCAPE
LOCAL_SEPARATOR2_ESCAPE.formula: exists C, exists S in Sep_2(C), exists psi in Col_L(S): not Closed(C,S,psi).
LOCAL_SEPARATOR2_ESCAPE.interpretation: Only this particular separator state fails. Another 2-separator may still be universally good; no universal claim is falsified.

R2_SEPARATOR2_COMPOSITION_ESCAPE.label: R2_SEPARATOR2_COMPOSITION_ESCAPE
R2_SEPARATOR2_COMPOSITION_ESCAPE.strong_formula: exists authoritative C in domain such that Sep_2(C)=empty OR for every S in Sep_2(C), [Col_L(S) nonempty AND exists defeating psi_S with a certified escaping component D_{S,psi_S}].

path_A_no_separator.conclusion: Because the domain already has Cut(C)=empty and C is connected, vertex connectivity satisfies kappa(C)>=3.
certificate: complete authoritative C and exact lists
complete graph-only Sep_2(C) enumeration showing empty

path_B_all_separators_defeated.condition: Sep_2(C) nonempty and every S in Sep_2(C) has at least one defeating proper list-respecting psi_S.
certificate: for every S, exact nonempty Col_L(S) enumeration receipt
for every S, one defeating psi_S
exact frozen propagation transcript for each defeating state
exact surviving connected D_{S,psi_S} and exact lists
tw(D)>3 with explicit frozen forbidden-minor model
D is not exactly a six-vertex literal octahedron
independent replay of separator-set completeness and every defeating state

R2_SEPARATOR2_COMPOSITION_ESCAPE.consequence_ceiling: There exists an authoritative cut-vertex-free residual whose unresolved interaction is not universally decomposed by any two-vertex separator under the current terminal library.

R3_GATE_UNRESOLVED.label: R3_GATE_UNRESOLVED
R3_GATE_UNRESOLVED.condition: Neither theorem-level R1 nor complete strong-R2 certificate is established.

required: tw(D)>3 certified by explicit minor model from {K5,OCTAHEDRON,WAGNER_V8,PENTAGONAL_PRISM}
D is not exactly a six-vertex literal octahedron
all separator/boundary restrictions encoded in exact propagated lists

mandatory_quantifier_controls.name: TWO_SEPARATOR_MIXED_CONTROL
mandatory_quantifier_controls.structure: Synthetic cut-vertex-free residual with two 2-separators S1,S2.
required_behavior: S1 has at least one escaping proper boundary assignment.
S2 closes for every proper boundary assignment.

mandatory_quantifier_controls.name: EMPTY_SEPARATOR_STATE_CONTROL
required_behavior: Classify S as GOOD_2 by boundary-UNSAT semantics.
No defeating psi is demanded from an empty state set.
R2=false for any C having this good separator.

mandatory_quantifier_controls.name: NO_SEPARATOR2_CONTROL
mandatory_quantifier_controls.structure: Synthetic connected cut-vertex-free graph with Sep_2(C)=empty and a mocked nonterminal label.
required_behavior: kappa>=3 conclusion is allowed only because Cut(C)=empty is also verified.

anti_cheat: Do not stop after the first bad 2-separator when attempting R2.
Do not promote LOCAL_SEPARATOR2_ESCAPE to R2.
Do not choose S or psi using extension knowledge.
Do not treat Col_L(S)=empty as an escape; it makes S good.
Do not call failed TW3 heuristic search an escape; require explicit forbidden-minor certificate.
Do not call an exact literal six-vertex octahedron an escape.
Do not open separator size 3, backdoor size 2, tw4, repair, or new state language.
next_action: Separate authorization required. Audit only two-vertex separator composition on the frozen cut-vertex-free frontier and stop at R1/strong-R2/R3.
